scripts.build: pnpm --filter @rome/discord-cli build && pnpm --filter @rome/core build && pnpm build:apps && pnpm --filter rome-web build
scripts.build:docker-runtime: pnpm --filter @rome/discord-cli build && pnpm --filter @rome/core build && pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.scripts.build.json && node scripts/bundle-docker-core.mjs && pnpm obfuscate:docker-runtime && pnpm build:apps && pnpm --filter rome-web build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @rome-os/libs test && pnpm --filter @rome/discord-cli test && pnpm --filter @rome/core test && pnpm --filter rome-web test && pnpm --filter @rome-os/ui test && pnpm test:ui:padding && pnpm test:ui:tokens && pnpm test:ui:contract && pnpm test:ui:radius
scripts.test:unit: pnpm test:unit:rest && pnpm test:unit:core && pnpm test:unit:web
scripts.test:unit:rest: pnpm --filter @rome-os/libs test && pnpm --filter @rome/discord-cli test && pnpm --filter rome-desktop test && pnpm test:ci:areas && pnpm test:docker-runtime && pnpm test:release:targets && pnpm test:obs:dashboards && pnpm test:ui:padding && pnpm test:ui:tokens && pnpm test:ui:contract && pnpm test:ui:radius
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm --filter @rome/discord-cli test && pnpm --filter @rome/core test:coverage && pnpm --filter rome-web test && pnpm --filter @rome-os/ui test
scripts.test:ci: pnpm --filter @rome/discord-cli test && pnpm --filter @rome/core test:ci && pnpm --filter rome-web test
scripts.db:generate:apps: for d in rome_apps/*/drizzle.config.ts; do [ -f "$d" ] && (cd "$(dirname "$d")" && pnpm exec drizzle-kit generate); done
scripts.db:push:apps: for d in rome_apps/*/drizzle.config.ts; do [ -f "$d" ] && (cd "$(dirname "$d")" && pnpm exec drizzle-kit push); done
scripts.db:push: echo '⚠ Dev-only: pushes schema directly without migrations (excludes authoring DB)' && pnpm db:push:system && pnpm db:push:apps
scripts.test:ui:tokens: scripts/test-env.sh node --test scripts/check-utility-tokens.test.mjs scripts/tailwind-policy.test.mjs scripts/tailwind-rules/spacing.test.mjs scripts/tailwind-rules/radius.test.mjs
